set: A: the whole site: the six pages at rest on one sheet, the screens with the controls, and sheets across one visitor's visit through the live site

issues.where: Page 5 of 6, between the Human Verification card and the isolated Submit button
issues.what: At rest this reads like a partially populated form rather than a deliberate scene. The large bare area and detached button give no hint of the mechanical submit sequence that occupies this space later.
issues.fix: Give Submit a low-profile mount or recessed track that anchors it to the page from the start, then let that same part unfold into the larger mechanism.

issues.where: Page 3 of 6, closed states at 0:44.97 and 1:34.38
issues.what: With all three rows shut, this is the closest thing to a repeat scene: the three empty fields on the right echo About You, while the rotary dial, date wheels and crank that distinguish this page are entirely hidden.
issues.fix: Give the three closed rows a restrained preview of their own hardware, such as a dial face, number wheel and crank socket, without opening any controls in advance.

issues.what: The panel looks like part of the same site, but it ends at an apology. The desktop still offers a film alternative, while the visitor who cannot enter the application has no visible route to that alternative.
issues.fix: Put the same Watch the film instead action below the apology, styled as a secondary control in the existing material palette.
